HEAD_META_DESCRIPTION: Read reviews of FastComments from the site owners, developers and moderators who run it, and leave your own. Every review is published after moderation.
HERO_SUBHEAD: Real reviews from people running FastComments on their sites today, collected with the same ratings and reviews widget you can add to your own pages.
WRITE_REVIEW_NOTE: Pick a star rating and write a few sentences about your experience. Reviews are published after a quick moderation check.
TRANSCRIBED_NOTE: Reviews labelled "Transcribed from external provider" were written on a third-party review site before reviews moved here. They are reproduced in our own words with the original rating and date.
DOGFOOD_BODY: This page runs the FastComments comment widget with a star question, plus the reviews summary widget. Add the same ratings and reviews to your own site in minutes.
